title: World Models' Last Exam in Physics
headline: Testing Video World Models: A Physics-Based Benchmark for Reliable Prediction
tldr: Video world models can generate realistic-looking sequences that violate physical laws, raising doubts about their use in embodied AI. We propose a measurement-based benchmark, World Models' Last Exam in Physics, to directly assess physical consistency.
significance: This benchmark provides a rigorous, physics-grounded evaluation that could improve the safety and reliability of AI systems relying on video world models.

title: Building Rome from a Single Image
headline: Reconstructing Rome: 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image for Urban Modeling
tldr: This work introduces a method to generate complete 3D scene meshes from a single image, extending beyond indoor scenes to complex outdoor environments like Rome. By leveraging pretrained 3D generators and a novel shape prior, the approach reconstructs unseen surfaces and produces accurate point‑cloud representations.
significance: It enables realistic 3D reconstruction of diverse urban landscapes from minimal data, advancing applications in virtual tourism and urban planning.

title: QF3: Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients
headline: Fast Flow RL: QF3 Accelerates Flow Policy Learning for Robots
tldr: We present QF3, an online off‑policy RL algorithm that trains flow policies using filtered Q‑gradients and flow matching. The method speeds up learning and improves performance over existing flow‑policy baselines.
significance: QF3 bridges the gap between demonstration‑based flow policies and reinforcement learning, enabling faster, more efficient robot control.

title: Algebraic Tensor Network Renormalization and Holographic duality
headline: Tensor Network Renormalization Unveils Holographic Duality in Quantum Phase Transitions
tldr: Tensor network renormalization with generalized symmetries offers a discrete spacetime framework to reformulate conformal field theory. This approach provides a promising route toward a complete holographic formulation of quantum phase transitions.
significance: It bridges tensor network methods with holographic duality, potentially enabling new computational tools for strongly correlated quantum systems.

title: Conformal Prediction Sets Quantify Information Gain: A Theoretical Perspective
headline: Conformal Prediction Sets Quantify Information Gain: A Theoretical Perspective
tldr: This paper establishes an information-theoretic foundation for conformal prediction, linking prediction set size to decision-theoretic entropy. It shows how uncertainty quantification can be rigorously interpreted as information gain.
significance: It bridges a gap between practical uncertainty measures and formal information theory, enhancing the interpretability of conformal prediction.

title: 4D-HOF: Hand-Object Flow Matching for Feed-Forward 4D Interaction Reconstruction
headline: Fast 4D Hand-Object Interaction Reconstruction with Vision Foundation Models
tldr: 4D-HOF delivers real‑time 4‑dimensional hand‑object reconstructions by feeding coarse estimates from vision foundation models into a feed‑forward pipeline. This eliminates costly per‑sequence optimization and stabilizes interaction prediction compared to generative approaches.
significance: It enables efficient, stable 4D hand‑object interaction modeling for applications like AR/VR and robotics.

title: IdeaAnchor: Teaching LLMs to Turn Literature into Research Ideas
headline: IdeaAnchor: Guiding LLMs to Generate Research Ideas from Literature for Future Studies
tldr: IdeaAnchor introduces a structured supervision framework that teaches large language models to synthesize related papers and identify research gaps. This approach enables automated literature-grounded ideation, accelerating the generation of novel research directions.
significance: By providing a systematic way for LLMs to understand and combine scholarly works, IdeaAnchor could dramatically speed up hypothesis generation across scientific fields.

title: DepthWorld: 3D World Model for Robot Manipulation
headline: DepthWorld: Real-Time 3D World Models for Precise Robot Manipulation and Planning
tldr: DepthWorld introduces a data-driven 3D world model that overcomes the limitations of RGB-only video models, enabling consistent spatial reasoning for robot manipulation tasks. By integrating depth cues and point-cloud consistency, it supports policy evaluation, improvement, and real-time planning.
significance: This work bridges the gap between visual perception and 3D geometry, providing a reliable foundation for advanced robotic decision-making.

title: ALIVE: Interaction-Aligned Object Insertion for First-Frame-Guided Video Editing
headline: ALIVE: Making Inserted Objects Interact in Video Editing for Realistic First-Frame Guided Editing
tldr: ALIVE lets users insert objects that naturally interact with the scene, using a single edited first frame and an object name instruction. The system aligns motion, lighting, and physics to make the added object appear alive.
significance: It bridges a long-standing gap in video editing by enabling realistic, interaction-aware object insertion.

title: Sherpa: Teaching LLMs to Teach Adaptively
headline: Sherpa: Adaptive Teaching for LLMs Tailored to Individual Learners in Real-Time
tldr: Sherpa equips large language models with adaptive teaching strategies that respond to each student's learning progress, moving beyond static demonstrations and preference data. By grounding instruction in real-time feedback, it promises more effective, personalized education.
significance: This work bridges the gap between problem-solving LLMs and personalized teaching, enabling more effective human-AI collaboration in education.

title: CtrlCache: Accelerating Interactive Video World Models with Control-Aware Caching
headline: CtrlCache: Speeding Interactive Video Generation with Control-Aware Caching
tldr: CtrlCache introduces a training-free caching strategy that reuses denoising states in interactive video world models, reducing the number of costly denoising iterations per chunk. By conditioning cache decisions on user controls, it achieves real‑time performance while preserving fidelity across video generations.
significance: This work enables near real‑time interactive video synthesis, a key step toward responsive AI-driven virtual environments.

title: Agent in a Bottle: Can LLM Agents Turn Their Capabilities Into Cheap, Scalable Artifacts?
headline: LLM Agents Bottling Their Skills: Cheap, Scalable Solutions for Large-Scale Tasks
tldr: Large language models excel at diverse tasks, but querying them millions of times is costly. This paper proposes BOTTLED, an approach where LLM agents generate task-specific, low-cost artifacts that balance quality and amortized cost.
significance: BOTTLED demonstrates how autonomous LLM agents can transform general-purpose models into efficient, reusable tools, reducing operational expenses for large-scale workloads.

title: One Figure, Every Canvas: Editable Flowchart Relayout via Agentic Pipeline
headline: One Figure, Every Canvas: Agentic Pipeline for Aspect‑Ratio‑Adaptive Flowchart Relayout
tldr: We introduce an agentic pipeline that automatically relayouts computational graph figures to fit any aspect ratio, preserving connectivity and visual clarity. The system leverages a foundation model to parse raster diagrams, generate vector representations, and apply layout heuristics, enabling seamless reuse across papers, slides, and social media.
significance: This work eliminates manual diagram adaptation, ensuring accurate representation of methods across diverse publication formats.

title: Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data
headline: Base Models Use Training Data Cues to Match RL‑Trained Reasoning Performance
tldr:
Researchers found that specific starting token cues, derived from training data, can steer base language models to perform reasoning tasks as well as models fine‑tuned with reinforcement learning. By fixing cues like “.

Okay”, the base model’s accuracy on math and coding benchmarks rivals RL‑trained counterparts.
significance: This demonstrates that simple cue engineering can unlock advanced reasoning in foundation models without costly RL fine‑tuning.

title: TranScope: What the Software Hides About LLM Training Data, the Hardware Reveals at Scale, and Accelerators Magnify
headline: TranScope Exposes Hidden LLM Training Data via Hardware Cycle-Level Analysis
tldr: TranScope reveals how large language models and vision transformers leak training data through microarchitectural side channels. The study demonstrates that hardware accelerators magnify these leaks, challenging the assumption that masked confidence protects privacy.
significance: This work uncovers a new class of privacy vulnerabilities in state-of-the-art foundation models, highlighting the need for hardware-aware defenses.

title: S2PD: Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion for Physically and Logically Consistent Video Generation
headline: Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion Improves Physical Consistency in Video Generation
tldr: S2PD combines high-noise autoregressive diffusion with low-noise parallel diffusion to enforce physical and symbolic rules in videos. The method achieves more realistic, logically consistent outputs compared to fully parallel models.
significance: It addresses a key limitation of current video diffusion models, enabling more reliable generation for applications requiring physical plausibility.

title: BiasFlow: Geometric Monitoring and Backbone Regularization for Spurious Feature Reliance
headline: BiasFlow: Monitoring Backbone Bias to Reduce Spurious Feature Reliance in Models
tldr: BiasFlow is a hook-based toolkit that monitors class-attribute centroid alignment, within-class separation, and feature-projection sensitivity to detect spurious feature reliance in frozen backbones. It enables researchers to evaluate and regularize backbone behavior when new heads are trained, improving worst-group accuracy.
significance: By providing fine-grained geometric diagnostics, BiasFlow helps mitigate bias in deep learning models, leading to more robust and fair predictions.

title: Learning to Read the Contextual Tokens in Diffusion Transformers
headline: Decoding Contextual Tokens in Multimodal Diffusion Transformers for Enhanced Understanding
tldr: This paper introduces a lightweight framework that interrogates dynamic contextual tokens in Multimodal Diffusion Transformers via natural language queries, revealing their role in multimodal generation. The method enables interpretable analysis of how visual and textual modalities interact during diffusion.
significance: By providing a transparent view into the hidden contextual space of MM‑DiTs, the work advances interpretability and could guide future design of multimodal generative models.

title: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
headline: Recursive Video In-Context Learning Boosts LLM-Driven Robot Performance for Dynamic Tasks
tldr: LLM agents orchestrate frozen vision-language-action policies, improving over episodes via text memory that records actions but not task details. However, embedding full demonstration videos slows inference, and keyframe simplifications lose critical grasp contact information.
significance: This approach demonstrates how recursive video in-context learning can enhance real-time robotic decision-making without retraining underlying perception models.

title: Anatomy-aware Fine-grained Multimodal Fusion for Laryngopharyngeal Cancer T-Staging Prediction Using CT and Radiology Report
headline: Anatomy-Aware Multimodal Fusion Improves CT-Based T-Staging for Laryngopharyngeal Cancer
tldr: This study introduces an anatomy-aware multimodal fusion framework that integrates CT images with radiology reports to predict T-staging of laryngopharyngeal cancer. The approach outperforms existing methods by accurately modeling structural relationships and fine-grained tumor invasion patterns, offering a non-invasive alternative to biopsy.
significance: Accurate, non-invasive T-staging can guide personalized treatment and reduce reliance on invasive biopsies.

title: Direct Intermediate Initialization for Tilted Diffusion Samplers
headline: Accelerating Tilted Diffusion Samplers via Direct Intermediate Initialization for Large-Scale Image Generation
tldr: We show that Gaussian-tilted intermediate distributions in diffusion samplers can be mapped back to weaker-conditioned clean-space posteriors, enabling analytic transport to noisy-space targets via Gaussian bridges. This approach simplifies the SMC sampler MCGDiff and improves sampling efficiency.
significance: This method reduces computational overhead and improves convergence for diffusion-based generative models, offering a practical advance for large-scale image synthesis.

title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points
headline: Looped Models Reimagined: Fixed Points Reduce Training, Decoding, and RL Costs
tldr: By steering recurrent states toward fixed points, looped language models cut training and decoding overhead, enabling truncated backpropagation, KV sharing, and a 1.79× faster distilled student. This approach also streamlines RL updates with minimal accuracy loss.
significance: It offers a scalable, cost-effective path to deploy efficient, high-performance language models.

title: UniSlider: Perceptually Uniform Sliders for Continuous Image Editing
headline: UniSlider: Making Image Editing Sliders Perceptually Uniform and Intuitive for Generative Models
tldr: UniSlider introduces a perceptually uniform slider that maps slider positions to consistent visual changes in generative image editing. By aligning slider values with human perception, it eliminates abrupt reversions and flat regions, improving user control over diffusion-based models.
significance: This work bridges the gap between technical strength parameters and user experience, enabling more reliable and intuitive image editing.

title: Less Decoder is More Encoder: Geometric Representation Learning from Novel View Synthesis
headline: Reevaluating Encoder-Based Novel View Synthesis for 3D Representation Learning in Practice
tldr: The study shows that encoder-based novel view synthesis fails to produce strong 3D representations, not due to supervision but due to subtle architectural choices. By reexamining these design decisions, the authors propose a more effective decoder-centric approach that improves geometric representation learning.
significance: This work highlights that architectural design, rather than supervision, is critical for effective 3D representation learning via novel view synthesis.

title: MoSE3: Learning World-Space SE(3) at Every Pixel
headline: MoSE3: Predicting Dense 6-DoF Motion Per Pixel from Monocular Video
tldr: MoSE3 introduces a feed-forward network that outputs full 6-DoF SE(3) motion for every pixel in monocular RGB video. This enables dense 3D point tracking with rotation and rigid-body motion, surpassing traditional 3-DoF translation-only methods.
significance: By modeling full SE(3) motion per pixel, MoSE3 provides richer motion understanding for dynamic scenes, facilitating applications like 3D reconstruction and motion segmentation.

title: 4DCodeBench: Benchmarking Agents on Inverse Graphics of Dynamic Scenes
headline: 4DCodeBench: Benchmarking Agents on Inverse Graphics of Dynamic Scenes for Code Generation
tldr: 4DCodeBench introduces a benchmark that evaluates agents' ability to reconstruct dynamic scenes from video by generating executable graphics programs. It requires translating visual data into compact scene representations and simulating physical dynamics, pushing the limits of inverse graphics and code generation.
significance: This benchmark advances research in inverse graphics by demanding agents produce full, executable 4D scene models, bridging perception and program synthesis.

title: What Should World Models Forget? Stratified Retention for Continual Adaptation
headline: Stratified Retention: How World Models Should Forget for Continual Adaptation
tldr: Continual learning often penalizes forgetting, but world models need to discard outdated knowledge as environments evolve. This paper proposes a stratified retention strategy that selectively forgets irrelevant information while preserving useful context.
significance: It redefines forgetting as a beneficial mechanism for adaptive world models, enabling more robust real‑time decision making.

title: RNADyn: A Benchmark for Generating and Understanding RNA Dynamics
headline: RNADynBench: A Unified Benchmark for RNA Dynamics Generation and Analysis
tldr: RNA functions through dynamic conformational changes that static structures miss. RNADynBench offers a standardized, large-scale dataset of 2,585 high-quality RNA molecular dynamics trajectories, enabling integrated generation and understanding of RNA motion.
significance: It bridges the gap between trajectory generation and dynamics interpretation, providing a common platform for advancing RNA research.

title: EyeRobot 2.0: Active Gaze for Precise Manipulation without Wrist Cameras
headline: EyeRobot 2.0 Uses Active Gaze for Precise Bimanual Manipulation Without Wrist Cameras
tldr: EyeRobot 2.0 employs active gaze by swiveling two eye viewpoints to focus a single stereo camera on a 3D fixation point, enabling fine-grained bimanual manipulation. The system processes images foveally, allocating more visual tokens to the image centers for efficient, real-time computation.
significance: This approach eliminates the need for wrist-mounted cameras, simplifying robotic hardware while maintaining high manipulation precision through focused visual attention.

title: From Mixing to Tearing: Graph Decomposition in Decentralized Optimization via Message Passing
headline: Decentralized Optimization via Graph Decomposition: From Mixing to Tearing
tldr: The paper introduces a message‑passing framework that decomposes a graph to accelerate decentralized optimization of smooth strongly convex functions. By tearing the network into subgraphs, agents can perform local updates more efficiently than traditional gossip or spanning‑tree methods.
significance: It offers a scalable, communication‑efficient alternative for distributed machine learning on large networks.

title: Fractal dimension of critical Gaussian free field sign clusters
headline: Fractal Dimension of Critical Gaussian Free Field Sign Clusters on Low-Dimensional Graphs
tldr: We analyze sign clusters of the Gaussian free field on transient weighted graphs below the mean-field regime and establish that macroscopic cluster definitions via diameter, volume, or capacity coincide. This yields a precise fractal dimension for critical clusters and a macroscopic equivalence property.
significance: It resolves long-standing questions about the scaling behavior of sign clusters in low-dimensional random fields.

title: LESSER: Post-Training Data Selection with Output-Layer Gradients
headline: LESSER: Efficient Post-Training Data Selection Using Output-Layer Gradients for Large Language Models
tldr: LESSER introduces a lightweight method that ranks post-training samples by their output-layer gradients, avoiding costly full-parameter backpropagation. The approach achieves comparable downstream performance to full-gradient methods while dramatically reducing computational overhead.
significance: By leveraging output-layer gradients, LESSER enables scalable data selection for large language models, making post-training fine-tuning more accessible.

title: Maximum-Entropy Extension of Quantum Correlation Functions from Short Real-Time Dynamics
headline: Extending Quantum Correlation Functions Using Maximum-Entropy from Short Dynamics
tldr: The paper presents a maximum‑entropy method to extrapolate quantum correlation functions beyond the short real‑time window available in simulations, enabling accurate spectral analysis. This approach bridges the gap between computational feasibility and the need for long‑time dynamics in studying quasiparticle excitations.
significance: It provides a practical tool for resolving spectral features in quantum systems without prohibitive simulation times.

title: Moore, Escher, Penrose: A Conformal Golden Braid
headline: Escher, Moore, and Penrose Reveal a Conformal Golden Braid in 1956 Print Gallery
tldr: An analysis of Escher’s 1956 lithograph Print Gallery uncovers a hidden conformal mapping that intertwines the golden ratio with Penrose tiling. The study links visual art to modern mathematical frameworks, offering new insights into symmetry and geometry.
significance: It bridges art and advanced geometry, demonstrating how classic works anticipate contemporary mathematical concepts.

title: Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real: Guided Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
headline: Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real: Autonomous Robot Skill Refinement Without Weight Updates
tldr: RPG is a framework that autonomously improves robot execution systems by identifying manipulation capabilities in offline datasets and refining policies without changing model weights. It reduces human effort in skill development, reward design, and perception-control integration.
significance: RPG enables scalable, low-maintenance robot skill development, accelerating deployment across varied tasks.

title: Cost-augmented Schrödinger bridges on graphs are exactly solvable: a Feynman-Kac tilt replaces learned control
headline: Exactly Solvable Cost-Augmented Schrödinger Bridges on Graphs via Feynman-Kac Tilt
tldr: The paper shows that adding state costs to a Schrödinger bridge on a graph can be handled analytically by incorporating the cost into the reference process through a Feynman-Kac tilt, eliminating the need for learning control rates. This yields an exactly solvable model that replaces learned dynamics with a simple bridge formulation.
significance: It provides a closed-form solution for cost-augmented transport on graphs, simplifying algorithms for stochastic control and optimal transport.

title: SW1D: A Python package for seismic surface wave solutions in 1-D elastic media
headline: SW1D: Python Package for Computing Rayleigh and Love Wave Dispersion in 1‑D Elastic Media
tldr: SW1D provides a Python implementation of a propagator‑matrix solver for surface wave eigenvalue problems, enabling fast calculation of Rayleigh and Love wave dispersion curves and synthetic seismograms in 1‑D isotropic media. The package supports point source excitations and outputs frequency‑domain solutions for use in seismic modeling and inversion.
significance: It democratizes advanced surface‑wave analysis by offering an open‑source, easy‑to‑use tool that replaces legacy, language‑specific codes.

title: Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models
headline: Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Models for Bidirectional Language Generation and Global Constraint Satisfaction
tldr: This paper introduces hierarchical continuous diffusion language models that preserve token dependencies during parallel decoding, enabling efficient bidirectional generation with global constraints. The approach improves over discrete diffusion by modeling continuous latent spaces and hierarchical sampling, achieving state‑of‑the‑art performance on benchmark language tasks.
significance: It advances diffusion-based language modeling by overcoming the independence bottleneck, paving the way for more coherent, globally constrained text generation.

title: Hyperbolic lattices with mass disorder: Phases and phase transitions
headline: Hyperbolic Lattice Models Reveal Dirac, Fermi, and Flat Band Phases with Disorder
tldr: We study nearest-neighbor tight-binding models on hyperbolic lattices and find that disorder leads to distinct density-of-states behaviors: a vanishing DOS (Dirac liquid), finite DOS (Fermi liquid), and diverging DOS (flat band). These results highlight the role of lattice geometry in electronic phases.
significance: This work demonstrates how hyperbolic geometry can engineer exotic electronic phases, offering a new platform for exploring disorder-driven transitions.

title: The Missing Primitive: Diagnosing and Repairing Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models
headline: Diagnosing and Repairing Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models
tldr: This paper introduces a systematic framework for evaluating the mathematical reasoning abilities of large language models. By diagnosing specific weaknesses and proposing targeted repair strategies, the authors demonstrate improved performance on benchmark problems.
significance: The study provides a foundational methodology for assessing and enhancing the structural mathematical understanding of LLMs, which is critical for reliable deployment in scientific and engineering tasks.

title: Trust the Direction, Search the Step: Zero-and-First-Order Methods for LLM Fine-Tuning
headline: Optimizing LLM Fine-Tuning: Zero-and-First-Order Methods Decouple Direction and Step Size
tldr: The paper introduces ZFO, a lightweight framework that separates direction selection from step-size in LLM fine-tuning. By combining trusted first-order optimizers with zero-order step search, it achieves faster convergence without sacrificing stability.
significance: This approach offers a practical solution to the step-size dilemma in large-scale neural network training, improving efficiency for fine-tuning foundation models.

title: Generative modeling of intrinsically disordered protein regions by reinforcing sparse autoencoder features
headline: Generative Modeling of Intrinsically Disordered Protein Regions Using Sparse Autoencoders
tldr: Researchers develop a generative framework that captures the flexible nature of intrinsically disordered protein regions by reinforcing sparse autoencoder features. The approach improves functional prediction and design of IDRs beyond traditional structure-based methods.
significance: This work provides a new foundation-model approach to design and analyze the challenging, flexible regions of proteins, opening avenues for targeted therapeutics.

title: DMAD: Distribution Matching as Adversarial Distillation for Fast Visual Generation
headline: Fast Visual Generation via Distribution Matching as Adversarial Distillation (DMAD)
tldr: DMAD reformulates distribution matching into a classification task, eliminating the need for an auxiliary diffusion model. This yields a lightweight, few-step student that achieves fast visual generation with comparable quality.
significance: By removing the auxiliary model, DMAD reduces memory and compute overhead, enabling rapid deployment of diffusion-based generators.

title: Higher-Order Molecular Grammars for Generative and Foundation Models in Chemistry
headline: Higher-Order Grammars Enable Efficient Generation of Complex Molecules
tldr: We introduce higher-order molecular grammars that capture ring systems and motifs directly, improving generative model fidelity. These grammars reduce computational cost and enable decoding of valid molecules, advancing foundation models in chemistry.
significance: This work bridges the gap between expressive chemical representations and scalable generative modeling, paving the way for more accurate drug discovery pipelines.

title: Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free
headline: Looped Transformers: Efficient Parameter Sharing for Near-Free Decoding in Large Language Models
tldr: Looped Transformers reuse a single block across multiple recurrent loops, enabling parameter efficiency. By retaining intermediate states during decoding, they provide weak-and-strong prediction pairs without extra models.
significance: This approach reduces computational cost while improving decoding quality, offering a practical advantage for large language models.

title: Single-Particle Spectral Estimation
headline: Learning Hamiltonian Weights via Global Unitary Obfuscation in Single-Particle Systems
tldr: We propose a method to recover the weights of a Hamiltonian composed of non-interacting modes, even when the system is globally rotated by an unknown unitary. The approach leverages spectral estimation techniques to disentangle the target modes from an arbitrary spectator Hamiltonian.
significance: This work enables efficient characterization of complex quantum systems where global symmetries obscure local interactions.

title: SoftServe: A Scalable Quasi-Newton Method for Deep Learning
headline: SoftServe: Scalable Quasi-Newton Optimization for Deep Learning Without Line Searches
tldr: SoftServe introduces a family of quasi-Newton methods that scale to large deep learning models while avoiding line searches and curvature corrections. The approach maintains positive definiteness and delivers efficient, robust optimization for non-convex problems.
significance: It enables large-scale, efficient training of deep neural networks by combining quasi-Newton efficiency with scalability.

title: OmniSeek: Native Tool Integration for Multi-turn Audio-Visual Reasoning
headline: OmniSeek Empowers LLMs with Dynamic Audio-Visual Tool Use for Multi-Turn Reasoning
tldr: OmniSeek transforms an Omni-LLM into an active agent that can decide when to look or listen during a conversation, using native tool integration for evidence acquisition. By dynamically selecting temporal windows, it achieves efficient, multi-turn audio-visual reasoning in real time.
significance: This framework enables LLMs to interact with multimodal data streams more efficiently, opening new possibilities for real-time decision-making in complex environments.

title: Sphere Encoder 2
headline: Improving Sphere Encoder: Bridging Latent Sphere Gaps for Better One-Step Image Generation
tldr: The Sphere Encoder 2 paper addresses two key limitations of the original model: the concentration of latent points near the equator and the incomplete training rotation. By correcting these gaps, the model achieves higher quality, one-step image generation.
significance: This work enhances autoencoder-based generative models, enabling more reliable and high-fidelity image synthesis from latent spheres.

title: One Basis to Animate Them All: Gaussian Blendshape Distillation for Real-Time Avatars
headline: Fast Real-Time Avatar Animation via Gaussian Blendshape Distillation
tldr: We show that pretrained 3D Gaussian avatars can be animated efficiently by approximating them with a linear combination of identity-independent blendshapes. Our GALA method distills neural inference into a lightweight linear model, enabling real-time avatar animation without sacrificing visual quality.
significance: This approach dramatically reduces computational cost, making high-fidelity avatar animation feasible on consumer hardware.

title: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards
headline: KaliBench: Benchmarking LLM-Generated Cybersecurity Commands on Kali Linux Without Runtime Overhead
tldr: KaliBench introduces a fine-grained benchmark that evaluates LLMs on their ability to produce executable Kali Linux tool commands. The dataset includes runtime-free verifiable rewards, enabling objective measurement of tool invocation accuracy.
significance: This benchmark bridges the gap between knowledge-based LLM evaluation and real-world cybersecurity tool usage, providing a practical metric for operational readiness.

title: ROWBench: Do Video Models Render What the Program Specifies?
headline: Evaluating Visual Fidelity of Programmable World Models in Next-Gen Game Engines
tldr: Programmable world models separate dynamics from visual rendering, but their adherence to program rules is under-tested. This study introduces a benchmark to assess fine-grained visual fidelity in game engine contexts.
significance: The benchmark provides a systematic way to ensure that visual outputs match explicit program specifications, advancing reliable game engine development.

title: Embedding Prediction Helps Image Generation
headline: Predicting Embeddings Boosts Diffusion Transformer Image Generation for High-Resolution Visuals
tldr: NEPA trains a Transformer to predict the next continuous embedding, allowing the model to use predicted embeddings as conditioning during denoising. This reduces reliance on a fixed prompt and improves image generation quality and flexibility.
significance: By enabling dynamic conditioning, NEPA enhances diffusion models' adaptability and opens new avenues for controllable image synthesis.

title: ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research
headline: ScholarCatalyst: Benchmarking Retrieval of Inspiring Papers for New Scientific Research
tldr: ScholarCatalyst introduces a benchmark that evaluates AI systems' ability to retrieve prior papers that directly inspire new research, using curated datasets from researchers who cite foundational works. The benchmark highlights the gap between current AI retrieval models and human expertise in recognizing relevant scientific lineage.
significance: It provides a rigorous test for AI systems to emulate the human skill of spotting pivotal prior research, crucial for accelerating scientific discovery.

title: SILSA: Sliding-Window Slice Latents for Topology-Preserving High-Resolution 3D Generation
headline: SILSA: Sliding-Window Latents Preserve Topology for High-Res 3D Generation
tldr: SILSA introduces a sliding-window slice latent approach that maintains surface continuity while reducing token fragmentation in voxel-based 3D generation. By preserving topology, it lowers computational cost and improves fidelity for thin or highly connected shapes.
significance: This method enables more efficient, topologically consistent high-resolution 3D models, advancing realistic synthetic geometry creation.

title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World
headline: VISTA: Enabling Long-Horizon Vision for Multimodal Reasoning in Interactive Environments
tldr: We demonstrate that multimodal models can excel at reasoning when provided with a visual harness that offers long-horizon vision. VISTA allows these models to directly perceive and process visual observations in interactive environments, unlocking their potential across diverse tasks.
significance: VISTA bridges the gap between general-purpose multimodal models and complex interactive tasks, enabling more robust reasoning capabilities.

title: TACO: Ternary Absolute-max Column-wise One-sparse Optimizer for LLM Fine-Tuning
headline: TACO: Memory-Efficient Optimizer for Full-Parameter LLM Fine-Tuning, Reducing GPU Memory Footprint
tldr: TACO introduces a ternary absolute-max column-wise one-sparse optimizer that dramatically cuts optimizer state memory for full-parameter fine-tuning of large language models. By leveraging sparse updates, it enables training larger models on existing GPUs without sacrificing convergence speed.
significance: This work lowers the barrier to fine-tuning massive LLMs, making it feasible on commodity hardware and accelerating research.

title: FERPO: Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization
headline: FERPO: Enhancing Reinforcement Learning with Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Updates
tldr: FERPO introduces a novel entropy-regularized policy optimization that leverages forward action gradients, addressing inaccuracies in critic-derived gradients. The method improves stability and performance in continuous control tasks compared to existing gradient-based RL algorithms.
significance: By ensuring more reliable policy updates, FERPO advances the robustness of online RL in continuous control, potentially benefiting robotics and autonomous systems.

title: HiPhy: Hierarchical Alignment for Physically-Plausible Multi-Principle Video Generation
headline: Physically Plausible Video Generation with Hierarchical Alignment for Multi‑Principle Scenarios
tldr: HiPhy introduces a hierarchical alignment framework that enforces multiple physical laws in video generation, enabling realistic simulations of complex interactions like buoyancy and gravity. The model demonstrates improved physical plausibility while maintaining high visual fidelity on benchmark datasets.
significance: This work bridges the gap between visual realism and physical accuracy, paving the way for reliable AI‑driven simulations in science and entertainment.

title: InterEvolve: Test-Time Evolution of Reward Programs for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
headline: InterEvolve: Adapting Humanoid Controllers at Test Time for New Loco-Manipulation Tasks
tldr: We demonstrate that a pre-trained humanoid controller can be repurposed for unseen tasks by evolving its reward program during deployment. This approach improves performance without retraining and retains learned skills.
significance: This method enables rapid deployment of versatile humanoid robots in dynamic environments without costly retraining.
